query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQD_INSP_INFO ( STEP_SEQ, WAFER_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP, FILETIMESTAMP, TECHNOLOGY, PRODUCT, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID , STEP_ID , TEST , SLOT_ID, SETUP_SEQ, STATUS , MAIN_EQ, ROUTE , OPER , INSPECTION_EQ, INSPECTION_PARAM, DEFECTS, CLASSIFIED_DEFECTS , KILLER_DEFECTS, RANDOM_DEFECTS, ADDER_KILLER_DEFECT, ADDER_RANDOM_DEFECT, CLUSTERS, ADDER_CLUSTERS , CLUSTER_AREA , DEFECT_DD, KILLER_DEFECT_DD, RANDOM_DEFECT_DD, INSPECTED_DIE, DEFECTIVE_DIE , ADDER_DEF_DIE , KILL_DEF_DIE , KILL_ADDER_DEF_DIE, IMAGES , SCAN_AREA , ADDER_DEFECTS , KILL_RND_DEFECTS, RETICLE_ID, INTERLOCK_FLAG , STEPPER_EQ ) VALUES( :step_seq ,:wafer_seq ,TO_TIMESTAMP(:resulttimestamp,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS') ,TO_TIMESTAMP(:filetimestamp,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS') ,:technology ,:product ,:lot_id ,:wafer_id ,:step_id ,:test ,:slot_id ,:setup_seq ,:status ,NVL(:main_eq,'UNKNOWN') ,:route ,:oper ,:inspection_eq ,:inspection_param ,:defects ,:classified_defects ,:killer_defects ,:random_defects ,:adder_killer_defect ,:adder_random_defect ,:clusters ,:adder_clusters ,:cluster_area ,:defect_dd ,:killer_defect_dd ,:random_defect_dd ,:inspected_die ,:defective_die ,:adder_def_die ,:kill_def_die ,:kill_adder_def_die ,:images ,:scan_area ,:adder_defects ,:kill_rnd_defects ,:reticle_id ,:interlock ,:stepper_eq)

UPDATE TQD_INSP_INFO SET FILETIMESTAMP = TO_TIMESTAMP(:filetimestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ,STATUS = :status ,CLASSIFIED_DEFECTS = :classified_defects ,KILLER_DEFECTS = :killer_defects ,ADDER_KILLER_DEFECT = :adder_killer_defects ,KILLER_DEFECT_DD = :killer_defect_dd ,KILL_DEF_DIE = :kill_def_die ,KILL_ADDER_DEF_DIE = :kill_adder_def_die ,IMAGES = :images ,KILL_RND_DEFECTS = :kill_rnd_defects WHERE STEP_SEQ = :step_seq
SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:fromtime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:totime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
SELECT DISTINCT LOT_ID FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:fromtime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:totime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND PRODUCT = :product

SELECT DISTINCT WAFER_ID FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:fromtime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:totime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND PRODUCT = :product AND LOT_ID = :lot_id

SELECT STEP_ID,RESULTTIMESTAMP,STEP_SEQ,SETUP_SEQ FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:fromtime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:totime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND PRODUCT = :product AND LOT_ID = :lot_id AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id

SELECT STEP_SEQ, WAFER_SEQ FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP ( :fromtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP ( :totime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND PRODUCT = :product AND LOT_ID = :lot_id AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND STEP_ID IN ( :step_id)
SELECT SETUP_ID,SETUP_SEQ FROM TDMS_SETUP WHERE SETUP_SEQ IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SETUP_SEQ FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE PRODUCT=:product )
SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT, STEP_ID, LOT_ID FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE RESULTTIMESTAMP BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(:fromtime,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:totime,'YYYYMMDD') AND LOT_ID LIKE :lot_id
SELECT * FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE PRODUCT = :product AND LOT_ID = :lot_id AND WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND STEP_ID = :step_id ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC

SELECT * FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE LOT_ID = :lot_id
SELECT STATUS, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID, INSPECTION_EQ FROM TQD_INSP_INFO ORDER BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID

SELECT A.PRODUCT AS PRODUCT, B.EQUIP_MODEL AS FORMAT FROM TQD_INSP_INFO A, TQD_UPDATESRV B WHERE A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.STEP_ID = :step_id AND A.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND A.INSPECTION_EQ = B.EQUIP_ID ORDER BY A.RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC

SELECT * FROM TQD_INSP_INFO A ,(SELECT MAX(RESULTTIMESTAMP) AS RESULTTIMESTAMP, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE STEP_ID = :step_id AND PRODUCT = :product AND LOT_ID = :lot_id GROUP BY LOT_ID, WAFER_ID) B WHERE A.RESULTTIMESTAMP = B.RESULTTIMESTAMP AND A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND A.WAFER_ID = B.WAFER_ID ORDER BY A.WAFER_ID
